name: Formcn
summary: Shadcn form builder: design single or multi-step forms with Zod validation and install the generated code.
description: Visual builder that generates production-ready shadcn/ui forms — single-step or multi-step — with Zod client/server validation and ARIA-accessible components. Formcn AI scaffolds form field components, and the generated code plus dependencies come into your project with one command via the shadcn registry CLI. Ships form templates, a changelog and a public roadmap.
contains: single-step and multi-step shadcn forms from a visual builder
Zod client/server validation with ARIA accessibility
generated code and dependencies installed with one command via the shadcn registry CLI
field types: tags input, date picker, file upload, combobox, slider, rating, multi-select
form templates (e.g. signup), changelog and roadmap
works with any React framework; no longer tied to Next.js
